indexes.//: Hierarchical pre-filter, then vector search inside the survivors. The array-contains on node_urns cuts the corpus to the handful of chunks that could possibly be relevant before the ANN runs at all — which is why retrieval here is cheap. Dimension is 1536 because Firestore caps vector indexes at 2048 and a naive 3072-dim embedding will not index; use Matryoshka truncation.
Everything under this node, at any depth, in one query — the materialised path doing its job.
The measured series, newest first. This is what consistent_with(asset.history) reads, and what makes a wear RATE computable rather than just a wear reading.
The same series across every component on a machine.
